<project name="Greeting" xmlns:mps="antlib:jetbrains.mps.build.ant" default="generate">
  <property name="artifacts.mps" location="${SCRATCH}/cache/tools/jetbrains-mps-2026.1.2/dist/MPS 2026.1.2"/>
  <taskdef uri="antlib:jetbrains.mps.build.ant" resource="jetbrains/mps/build/ant/antlib.xml">
    <classpath>
      <pathelement location="${SCRATCH}/cache/tools/jetbrains-mps-2026.1.2/dist/MPS 2026.1.2/lib/ant/lib/ant-mps.jar"/>
      <fileset dir="${SCRATCH}/cache/tools/jetbrains-mps-2026.1.2/dist/MPS 2026.1.2/lib"><include name="*.jar"/></fileset>
    </classpath>
  </taskdef>
  <target name="generate">
    <mps:generate mpshome="${SCRATCH}/cache/tools/jetbrains-mps-2026.1.2/dist/MPS 2026.1.2" fork="true">
      <jvmarg value="-Djava.awt.headless=true"/>
      <chunk><module file="${SCRATCH}/340-9i_e73c2/project/languages/l/Language.mpl"/><module file="${SCRATCH}/340-9i_e73c2/project/solutions/s/Solution.msd"/></chunk>
    </mps:generate>
  </target>
</project>

reproduction_command: ant -noinput generate; javac -d classes <generated .java>; java -cp classes <generated main>
